manaNeeded: {7}{G}{G}{G}{U}{U} each turn plus enough mana to pay for commander tax the first turn, if applicable
notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight lands, three of which are Islands.
description:
Cast Walk the Aeons with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning the three Islands from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Journey to the Oracle either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
Resolve Journey to the Oracle, putting the three Islands from your hand onto the battlefield and returning Journey to the Oracle to your hand.
The Islands enter the battlefield, triggering Aesi three times.
Resolve the first Aesi trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the remaining Aesi triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat each turn.
